cards.name: Marquee
cards.welcome_benefit: 40,000 YES Rewardz points (~Rs.10,000 value) on joining-fee payment; 20,000 points as renewal benefit when annual fee is charged.
cards.lounge_access: Domestic: unlimited but requires Rs.1L spend in preceding quarter (rule effective Apr 2025). International: unlimited (Priority Pass/Mastercard lounges). 2 guest visits/quarter shared across domestic+international.
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver on fuel transactions Rs.400-Rs.5,000; monthly cap applies (~Rs.500/cycle).
cards.reward_exclusions: Rent, wallet loads, fuel, government, marketing/advertising earn nothing; education/insurance/utilities earn reduced 10 RP/Rs.200.
cards.eligibility: High income segment; typically Rs.1.5-2L+/month income, CIBIL 750+.
cards.notes: Flagship card. Online 36 RP/Rs.200 (4.5%) applies only up to Rs.1L online spend/month (=18,000 bonus RP), offline 18 RP/Rs.200 (2.25%). rupee_per_point 0.25 = flights/hotels via YES Rewardz; vouchers devalued to ~Rs.0.15/pt. Points redemption capped at 70% of invoice value and 3L points/month on flights/hotels. BOGO BookMyShow up to 3 tickets/month; 4 golf games/year. Yes Bank has changed card T&Cs frequently since 2024 - verify before applying.

cards.name: Reserv
cards.welcome_benefit: Joining fee waived on Rs.40,000 spend within 30 days; 8,000 bonus points as renewal benefit when annual fee is charged.
cards.milestone_benefits: Optional paid subscription plans: 3X plan Rs.3,500/yr (6% online / 4.5% offline), 5X plan Rs.5,000/yr (9% online / up to 15% offline on travel, dining, fashion, healthcare only).
cards.lounge_access: Domestic: 3/quarter, requires Rs.1L spend in preceding quarter. International: 6/year. Direct card swipe; no Priority Pass kit.
cards.reward_exclusions: Rent, wallet loads, fuel and UPI earn nothing; utilities/insurance/education/govt/tax earn reduced 6 RP/Rs.200.
cards.eligibility: Affluent segment; income requirement not published, CIBIL 750+ preferred.
cards.notes: Erstwhile YES First Exclusive, rebranded RESERV in the 2023-24 lineup revamp. Online 24 RP/Rs.200 (3%), offline 12 RP/Rs.200 (1.5%). 36,000 RP/statement-cycle combined cap. rupee_per_point 0.25 = flights via YES Rewardz; vouchers ~Rs.0.10/pt. Redemption fee Rs.100+GST.

cards.name: Elite+
cards.welcome_benefit: Joining fee waived on Rs.20,000 spend within 30 days of activation.
cards.lounge_access: Domestic: 2-3/quarter (sources differ), requires Rs.50,000 spend in preceding quarter. International: 2-3/year.
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel, rent, wallet loads, EMI, cash advances earn nothing; utilities capped at 300 RP/month.
cards.eligibility: 21-60 years; salaried Rs.1L/month or self-employed ITR Rs.9L+.
cards.notes: Erstwhile YES Premia / YES Bank ELITE, relaunched as ELITE+ in the lineup revamp. Online 12 RP/Rs.200 (1.5%), offline 6 RP/Rs.200 (0.75%). Online points capped 12,000 RP/cycle. rupee_per_point 0.25 = flights/hotels; catalogue redemptions ~Rs.0.10/pt. Redemption fee Rs.100+GST. Sometimes offered LTF via digital channels.

cards.name: Select
cards.welcome_benefit: Joining fee waived on Rs.10,000 spend within 30 days.
cards.lounge_access: Domestic: 1/quarter, requires Rs.50,000 spend in preceding quarter. No international lounge.
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel, EMI conversions, cash withdrawals earn nothing.
cards.eligibility: 21-60 years; salaried Rs.50,000/month or self-employed ITR Rs.7.5L+.
cards.notes: Erstwhile YES Prosperity Edge, rebranded SELECT in the lineup revamp. Online 8 RP/Rs.200 (1%), offline 4 RP/Rs.200 (0.5%). Online points capped 5,000 RP/cycle. rupee_per_point 0.25 only on flights/hotels; movies/bills ~Rs.0.10/pt. Redemption fee Rs.100.

cards.name: Essence
cards.welcome_benefit: Vouchers worth Rs.1,000 on activation; joining fee waived on Rs.20,000 spend within first month.
cards.milestone_benefits: 5,000 bonus YES Rewardz on Rs.50,000 spend in first 90 days; 10,000 bonus on Rs.1L annual spend; birthday Rs.1,000 Myntra voucher and complimentary women-centric health check-up.
cards.lounge_access: Complimentary domestic lounge access every quarter (spend condition applies, in line with other Yes cards).
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel, rent, wallet loads (standard Yes Bank exclusions).
cards.eligibility: Women-centric card; standard Yes Bank income criteria (~Rs.25,000+/month).
cards.notes: Women-focused card launched post-revamp. 12 RP/Rs.200 (1.5%) on online fashion/beauty/travel/dining/grocery, 8 RP/Rs.200 other online, 4 RP/Rs.200 offline. BOGO movie ticket monthly on District. Renewal-waiver spend threshold not published (annual criteria exists) - verify.

cards.name: ACE
cards.welcome_benefit: Joining fee reversed on Rs.5,000 spend within 30 days.
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel, rent, wallet loads (standard exclusions).
cards.eligibility: 21-60 years; ~Rs.25,000/month salaried.
cards.notes: Entry card in the revamped lineup; several aggregators map it to the erstwhile Prosperity Rewards Plus slot. Online 8 RP/Rs.200 (1%), offline 4 RP/Rs.200 (0.5%). Credit Shield Rs.1L. Forex markup unverified (likely 2.75-3.5%).

cards.name: BYOC (Build Your Own Card)
cards.reward_currency: Cashback or YES Rewardz Points (chosen plan)
cards.lounge_access: 1 complimentary domestic lounge visit/quarter (depends on chosen perks).
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel excluded from rewards.
cards.eligibility: Standard Yes Bank criteria; fully digital customisation journey.
cards.notes: Subscription-fee card: Rs.49+GST/month for Rewards plan (8 RP/Rs.200 = 1% at Rs.0.25/pt) or Rs.99+GST/month for Cashback plan (1% cashback); annual_fee shown = Rs.49x12. Optional plastic upgrades: eco-friendly Rs.249, metal Rs.3,499 one-time. Modelled here as 1% cashback plan; perks (lounge, memberships) are user-selected. This is the card sometimes informally confused with 'Klarna' - Yes Bank has no Klarna card in India.

cards.name: EMI Credit Card
cards.reward_exclusions: No cashback on EMI-converted transactions; standard fuel/rent/wallet exclusions.
cards.eligibility: 21-60 years; salaried Rs.25,000/month or self-employed ITR Rs.5L+.
cards.notes: Transactions above Rs.5,000 auto-convert to EMI within ~5 working days at 16% p.a. reducing (1% processing fee, 3-12 month tenure). 1% cashback on retail (cap Rs.500/month); 3% on YES Cart (cap Rs.1,000/month). No lounge/movie/insurance frills.

cards.name: Wellness
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel, rent, wallet loads (standard exclusions).
cards.eligibility: 21-60 years; salaried Rs.20,000/month or ITR Rs.7.5L+.
cards.notes: Health-focused card with Aditya Birla Wellness tie-up. 20 RP/Rs.200 (2.5%) at chemists, 4 RP/Rs.200 elsewhere. Annual preventive health/eye/dental check-up, 6 fitness sessions/month via AB Multiply app, unlimited doctor/nutritionist consults. No spend-based fee waiver. Redemption fee Rs.100+GST.

cards.name: Wellness Plus
cards.lounge_access: Domestic: 2/quarter, requires Rs.50,000+ spend in preceding quarter.
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% on transactions above Rs.400 and below Rs.5,000.
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel, rent, wallet loads (standard exclusions).
cards.eligibility: 21-60 years; income Rs.20,000+/month or ITR Rs.7.5L+; CIBIL 750+.
cards.notes: 30 RP/Rs.200 (3.75%) at chemists, 6 RP/Rs.200 elsewhere. 12 fitness sessions/month, annual dental/eye/preventive check-ups, unlimited specialist consults, Rs.25L emergency hospitalisation cover. No fee waiver. Point value Rs.0.25 travel / Rs.0.10 vouchers.

cards.name: Paisabazaar PaisaSave
cards.variant: RuPay virtual companion card issued alongside Mastercard for UPI
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel, rent, wallet loads, EMI, government (standard cashback exclusions).
cards.eligibility: Sourced via Paisabazaar; standard entry-level criteria, CIBIL ~700+.
cards.notes: Co-branded with Paisabazaar; upgraded Dec 2025 to flat 6% cashback on dining + travel (cap Rs.3,000/month, then 1%) and 1% unlimited on other spends incl. UPI via RuPay virtual variant. First year free; some sources still show older Rs.399/Rs.1L-waiver terms vs Rs.499/Rs.1.2L - verify at application. RuPay variant only issued alongside the Mastercard.

cards.name: Klick (Kiwi)

merchant_bonuses.merchant: UPI scan & pay via Kiwi app

cards.milestone_benefits: Optional Kiwi Neon membership (Rs.999/yr): 2% base UPI cashback rising to 5% at Rs.1.5L+ monthly spend, plus up to 3 domestic lounge visits/year via DreamFolks.
cards.lounge_access: None on free tier; up to 3 domestic visits/year with Neon membership milestones.
cards.reward_exclusions: Telecom, utilities, jewellery, fuel, rent, insurance, education, government earn no cashback. Cashback capped monthly at 1% of credit limit.
cards.eligibility: 21-60 years; CIBIL 750+; fully digital KYC via Kiwi app.
cards.notes: Yes Bank's UPI credit card issued through the Kiwi app, rebranded 'Klick' (previously Kiwi Credit Card); Kiwi also issues on PNB/AU. Lifetime free. 1.5% cashback on UPI scan & pay, 0.5% on online payments, 2 RP/Rs.200 on non-UPI card spends. Min 500 Kiwis to redeem.

cards.name: POP-CLUB

merchant_bonuses.merchant: UPI via POP app (extra +5/100 over base)

cards.welcome_benefit: 500 POPcoins on activation plus partner perks advertised as worth ~Rs.5,000.
cards.milestone_benefits: Extra 1,500 POPcoins when annual spend crosses Rs.1.5L (alongside fee waiver).
cards.reward_exclusions: Standard exclusions (fuel, rent, wallet); accelerated POPcoins limited to 500+ partner brands via POPclub app.
cards.eligibility: Digital-first card via POPclub app; standard entry-level criteria.
cards.notes: Co-branded with POP (POPclub). 10 POPcoins/Rs.100 online, 2/Rs.100 offline, +5/Rs.100 extra on UPI via POP UPI app (RuPay). POPcoin rupee value is redemption-dependent (POP app brand store) and not officially published - rupee_per_point left null; effective value commonly estimated well below Re.1/coin. Validate value before optimising spend here.

cards.name: FinBooster (BankBazaar)
cards.variant: RuPay virtual companion card for UPI

merchant_bonuses.merchant: Online dining/grocery/apparel (up to 5X via reward subscription)

cards.welcome_benefit: Complimentary CreditStrong credit-fitness report subscription for first year.
cards.reward_exclusions: Standard Yes Bank exclusions (fuel, rent, wallet).
cards.eligibility: Sourced via BankBazaar; standard entry-level criteria.
cards.notes: Lifetime-free co-brand with BankBazaar built around credit-score tracking; points never expire, no accrual cap, points shareable with family. Accelerated (up to 5X) YES Rewardz on online dining/grocery/apparel via optional reward subscription; exact base earn rate not published on aggregators - left null. RuPay virtual companion (FinBooster RuPay) available for UPI.

cards.name: Uni
cards.reward_currency: Uni Coins (1% back, convertible to cashback/gold/vouchers)
cards.reward_exclusions: Standard exclusions; since Mar 2025 the 1% accrues as Uni Coins rather than direct cashback.
cards.eligibility: Digital onboarding via Uni app.
cards.notes: Issued by Yes Bank with fintech Uni (Uni NX Wave lineage). Flat 1% back on all spends, no merchant restriction, no cap; since 1 Mar 2025 earned as Uni Coins (convertible 1:1 to cashback, digital gold or Uni Store vouchers). 0% forex markup is a headline feature. Annual fee Rs.499 with waiver (threshold unpublished); several sources describe it as effectively lifetime free - verify. Uni GoldX variant (1% in 24K digital gold, LTF) also issued via Yes Bank/BoB.

cards.name: RIO RuPay
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% fuel surcharge waiver (fuel spends attract 1%+GST fee with caps).
cards.reward_exclusions: Utility spends above Rs.15,000/month attract 1%+GST fee (cap Rs.3,000); education/wallet/fuel attract 1%+GST fees with caps. Standard reward exclusions apply.
cards.eligibility: 21-60 years; salaried Rs.25,000/month or ITR ~Rs.5-7.5L; not available to existing Yes Bank cardholders.
cards.notes: Lifetime-free UPI RuPay card issued with the Rio digital platform. 3% Rio Coins on UPI spends, 1% on non-UPI, auto-credited to statement. Unusually generous lounge benefit for an LTF card - terms may tighten; high interest rate (3.99%/month) if revolving.

cards.name: RuPay Credit Card (companion virtual)
cards.reward_exclusions: P2P UPI transfers not allowed (merchant payments only); standard exclusions.
cards.eligibility: Only for existing Yes Bank Visa/Mastercard credit cardholders; shares the primary card's credit limit.
cards.notes: Free virtual RuPay add-on that UPI-enables an existing Yes Bank credit card. 4 RP/Rs.200 on UPI txns above Rs.2,000, 2 RP/Rs.200 otherwise. Not a standalone product. Redemption fee Rs.100.

cards.name: Private
cards.welcome_benefit: 25,000 points on first transaction; +10,000 points on Rs.10L spend within 90 days.
cards.lounge_access: Unlimited domestic and international (LoungeKey); ~12 guest visits/year; VIP airport meet & greet.
cards.reward_exclusions: Standard exclusions (rent, wallet, fuel).
cards.eligibility: Invite-only; ~Rs.5 crore total relationship value with Yes Bank private banking.
cards.notes: Ultra-HNI invite-only card. Earn-rate sources conflict (CardInsider: 40 RP/Rs.200 intl, 20 domestic; Paisabazaar: 24/16) - figures here use the higher set, treat as indicative. 12 golf green fees/year, private charter and cruise privileges. 0.5% forex is among the lowest in India.

cards.name: Private Prime
cards.welcome_benefit: 10,000 points on first transaction; +10,000 points on Rs.10L spend within 90 days.
cards.lounge_access: Unlimited domestic and international (LoungeKey) with guest visit caps.
cards.reward_exclusions: Standard exclusions (rent, wallet, fuel).
cards.eligibility: Invite-only; Yes Bank private/wealth relationship required.
cards.notes: Sibling of Yes Private with lower joining fee and welcome benefit; same earn structure (sources conflict on exact RP/Rs.200 - indicative). Invite-only, so terms are relationship-negotiated.

cards.name: First Business
cards.variant: RuPay Select variant launched at GFF 2025
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver; note fuel/toll transaction fees apply from 15 Oct 2025.
cards.reward_exclusions: Standard exclusions; fuel and toll/bridge transactions attract charges from Oct 2025.
cards.eligibility: Self-employed/business owners; Yes Bank business banking relationship helps.
cards.notes: Business card (12 RP/Rs.200). A YES Prosperity Business Credit Card also exists for smaller businesses; both gained RuPay Select variants in 2025. Details beyond fees/lounge are thin on aggregators - verify MITC before import.

cards.name: First Preferred
cards.lounge_access: Domestic lounge access with spend conditions (post-2024 rules applied to held cards).
cards.reward_exclusions: Standard exclusions.
cards.eligibility: No longer open to new applications.
cards.notes: Discontinued in the 2023-24 revamp; existing holders retained or migrated to ELITE+/RESERV. 16 RP/Rs.200 on travel & dining historically. Related sunset cards: YES First Exclusive (migrated to RESERV), YES Premia (became ELITE/ELITE+), YES Prosperity Edge (became SELECT).

cards.name: Prosperity Rewards
cards.reward_exclusions: Standard exclusions.
cards.eligibility: No longer open to new applications.
cards.notes: Legacy Prosperity-series entry card, discontinued in the lineup revamp (ACE now fills this slot). 4 RP/Rs.200 on dining & travel. Existing holders may still hold the card.

cards.name: Prosperity Cashback Plus
cards.reward_exclusions: Standard exclusions; category cashback had monthly caps.
cards.eligibility: No longer open to new applications.
cards.notes: Legacy 5% movies & groceries cashback card, discontinued in the revamp; held cards continue per legacy T&Cs.
